name: Kaijin X no Yokokujou
source:
Nao Igarashi, a former writer turned housewife, her husband is away on business overseas.
Around that time, she meets Saeko Yuuki—their neighbor and a former TV announcer.
And then their company gets a warning letter from "Phantom Thief X," the notorious thief making headlines everywhere.
The two of them team up and get moving, but...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ236237.html]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
五十岚奈央（Nao Igarashi）曾是一名作家，后来成为家庭主妇，她的丈夫正在海外出差。
大约在那个时候，她遇到了他们的邻居、前电视播音员佐惠子。
然后他们的公司收到了一封来自“怪盗X”的警告信，这位臭名昭著的小偷成了各地的头条新闻。
两人联手开始行动，但是……
